tooltip.quantumitems.window.shared: Shares one pool with its twins — draw from any, drain them all.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.ground: Touching the ground breaks the link.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.automation: Machines can pull ordinary items — taking the last one ends the link.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.shulker: Stable enough to survive inside a shulker box.
tooltip.quantumitems.shard.lore: A splinter of somewhere else. It remembers being two places at once.
tooltip.quantumitems.shard.source: Found where the old city sleeps in the dark.
tooltip.quantumitems.eye.lore: An eye that opens onto somewhere else.
tooltip.quantumitems.core.lore: The heart of the ritual circle.
tooltip.quantumitems.resonator.lore: A pedestal that steadies one stack for the rite.
quantumitems.ponder.tag.quantum_entangle: Entangle item stacks so distant windows share a single pool of items.
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_1: The ritual circle is built on a 5×5 floor of Amethyst Blocks
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_2: Place a Resonator on each of the four corners
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_3: Each Resonator holds a single stack of items
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_4: The Quantum Core stands at the center of the circle
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_5: The space above the floor must stay clear of other blocks
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_6: Once the circle is complete, it is ready to entangle items
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_1: Lay a single stack on just one Resonator
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_2: Then place a Quantum Shard on the Core to start the ritual
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_3: While the ritual runs, it pulls experience from nearby players
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_4: One Shard turns that stack into two entangled windows
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_5: The Shard is spent either way, success or failure
quantumitems.ponder.expand.text_1: To grow a network, first lay out every window it already has
quantumitems.ponder.expand.text_2: Then run the ritual again with another Shard
quantumitems.ponder.expand.text_3: Each ritual entangles one more window into the network
quantumitems.ponder.expand.text_4: The network caps at four windows — one for each Resonator
quantumitems.ponder.failure.text_1: The ritual is strict — mixed or mismatched stacks are a mistake
quantumitems.ponder.failure.text_2: Start it anyway, and the circle rejects the pattern
quantumitems.ponder.failure.text_3: It ends in a loud collapse — the Shard is spent, the items untouched
quantumitems.ponder.failure.text_4: Empty Resonators, stray stacks, or a network not fully laid out fail the same way

advancement.quantumitems.shard.descripti: Find a Quantum Shard where the old city sleeps in the dark

advancement.quantumitems.entangled.title: Entangled
advancement.quantumitems.entangled.descr: Complete a ritual and entangle your first network
